content: Our work is also related to latent variable PCFGs BIBREF79 , BIBREF80 , BIBREF81 , which extend PCFGs to the latent variable setting by splitting nonterminal symbols into latent subsymbols. In particular, latent vector grammars BIBREF82 and compositional vector grammars BIBREF83 also employ continuous vectors within their grammars. However these approaches have been employed for learning supervised parsers on annotated treebanks, in contrast to the unsupervised setting of the current work.
